name: Agent tool document
description: A tool as a content-addressed document in the agent's space: builtins are runtime bindings, lambdas carry TypeScript or Python source run in the execute sandbox, and mcp documents are projections of a remote MCP server's tools. The CID is computed over canonical DAG-CBOR exactly as the network encodes blobs, so publishing a tool is publishing bytes that already exist, and what exactly can this agent run is always answerable.

input.description: JSON Schema for the call input.

output.description: JSON Schema for the result, when declared.

source.description: Lambda source, shaped per the lambda ABI and run in the execute sandbox.

binding.description: Builtin executor id bound at boot; survives a fork of the document.

server.description: MCP tools: the account MCP server the call is proxied to.

remoteName.description: MCP tools: the tool's name on that server.
